name: wappflow-desktop
description: WappFlow Desktop — the native operating system for running a creative business (CRM · Studio · Contracts · Booking · Client Delivery · local AI).
author: WappFlow

scripts.lint:syntax: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');function w(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const fp=p.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(fp).isDirectory())w(fp);else if(f.endsWith('.js'))require('child_process').execSync('node -c '+JSON.stringify(fp))}}w('src');console.log('syntax ok')"

//notes: sharp + onnxruntime-node are optionalDependencies: the Local AI Engine lazy-requires them and degrades gracefully if a platform can't fetch a prebuilt binary, so `npm install` never hard-fails in a sandbox.
ONNX model files are NOT committed — drop them in src/main/ai/models/ and register them in the analyzer registry.
Requires a real GUI build machine (Win/macOS/Linux) to run + package — cannot launch/sign Electron in a headless CI sandbox.
